## Notes

Reviewed: #497, #709, #749 and #757 say `review-skipped` or carry no `Reviewed by:`; #282 and #283 carry none. #910 (the checks) and #946 (the sign-in) carry `Reviewed by:`, but the screens each criterion names landed in the unreviewed PRs [V gh pr view].

Shipped: `Deploy health` success on 6caca2d (#282), df34f96 (#283), d5ebc93 (#497), 4431c25 (#708), 4f571f5 (#709), 7f2db1a (#749), e0f16a9 (#757), 82a9edc (#910), 5e902cb (#946) and 4f691c0 (#959) [V gh run list]. Criterion 1 is not fully built, so Shipped is `no` for it by the rule.

Smoked: `smoke-live` runs on a schedule against main and opens only the routes whose files merged in the last 26 hours, as builder accounts; it checks that the page loads, throws nothing and shows no stray email address. Green runs since the last merge touching this feature: 2026-10-19 (cd913c7: auth-login, you and more, after #946), 10-21, 10-22 and 10-23 (cb892a7). `/onboarding` has no stable live address in `evals/smoke/live.spec.ts`, so it is skipped there, not passed; signup is never run and the zip change on /you is an action, so Smoked is `unknown` for every built criterion [V gh run view].

Changed since 2026-10-16: **criterion 1 is no longer built, and it gates launch.** #946 (2026-10-18, "one way to sign in") made `/auth/login` the only way in: email, then a 6-digit code, which creates the account and lands on the page the person came from (default `/`). Nothing then sends a new member to `/onboarding`: the proxy's gate is off until `PHONE_VERIFICATION_REQUIRED`, and the old `/auth/password` screen that defaulted to `/onboarding` is unlinked, kept for builder accounts. So a person who taps Sign in from You, a Page or the nav gets an account with only an email, never asked for a legal name, display name, zip or the 18+ box; only the feed banner's `?next=/onboarding` link still reaches the step. Criteria 3, 4, 6 and 7 still hold on the profile step itself, which is why they stay built. The fix is #847 (a signed-in member with no legal name is sent to the profile step), filed on 2026-10-16 for F077.1 and labelled `launch-blocking` today. Checked: the checks for criteria 1 and 5 (`signup-screens.test.tsx`, #851 and #855) walk the retired password screen, not the live form, so criterion 5 went from `checked yes` to `no`; check ticket #1014 filed. Criterion 8: Connecticut's planning regions now resolve (#959); the HUD source is still #849's.
